notes.title: Patchnotes 5.9-9.9.2025
notes.notes: [p][b]Gamepad Support[/b][/p][p]Gamepad support is largely complete. Only a few final touches remain in the Lobby and the Open World, specifically for Sabotage, Repair, and Inventory navigation.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Quality of Life[/b][/p][p]PC players can now press Tab in the Open World to quickly enlarge the minimap for easier orientation. We also received feedback requesting movement while the full map is open. Unfortunately, the engine does not support this, and since we’ll need the full map for navigation later on, we implemented this workaround instead.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41802577/89c66db141562efdb0a313afff59ebb104c8b492.png"][/img][/p][p][b]More Robust Networking[/b][/p][p]We’ve improved stability with our networking system. Previously, a bug in the framework prevented players from rejoining someone they had already played with in an earlier session unless they restarted the game. Now, simply clicking Join Party again or accepting a new invite will fix the issue.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Tutorial Updates[/b][/p][p]Tutorials now display the correct button icons depending on your device. Remapped keys are not yet reflected properly, but this feature is on the way. Additionally, gamepad navigation for switching between tutorial videos will be added soon.[/p][p][/p][p][b]UI Fixes[/b][/p][p]Several UI bugs have been resolved, particularly issues affecting the Settings menu.[/p][p] [/p]

notes.title: GG-Party Playtest is LIVE! 🚀
notes.notes: [p][/p][p]It’s happening! With just a one-day delay, we’ve officially kicked off our partly public Playtest, running until [b]September 14, 2025[/b]—and right after that, the Demo will go live.[/p][p]You can now invite your friends to join the Playtest via Steam.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41802577/3c24dfcbf497c1f537049a0529d2ccde88815a51.jpg"][/img][/p][p]We went all-in to make [b]GG-Party[/b] playtest-ready: from usability tweaks and game design upgrades to long-awaited features like tutorials and the long-requested compass.[/p][p]Sure, the minimap isn’t fully polished yet—it’ll get updates and a proper legend in the coming days. And yeah, the compass could look fresher. But the open-world game design and overall vibe should already hit the mark.[/p][p]🔥 [b]Every day at 9 PM German time (Berlin) until September 14, 2025, we’re hosting official Playtest sessions with the devs![/b] If you’re down to hang out and play together, hop into our Discord—the link is in-game or on our website: [/p][p][/p][p][url="https://gora.games"]https://gora.games[/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]Our hot recommendation: try the classic [b]GG-Party Mode[/b] with [b]1M, 5 minutes, and 10K starting money[/b].[/p][p]And here’s the big one: with the Demo, we’ll also be part of [b]Steam Next Fest[/b]—and we couldn’t be more hyped![/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41802577/9cd19d771bc2eeec23443973906461ead77ad370.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]BTW - since January we’ve dropped [b]500+ big and small changes[/b] (way too many to list here). So here’s the highlight reel:[/p][list][*][p][b]My Style[/b] – Create your own character! More outfits are in the works.[/p][/*][*][p][b]All Minigames[/b] – Reworked in detail with new levels and design updates.[/p][/*][*][p][b]UI & Logo[/b] – Revamped to feel more polished and consistent.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Expanded Settings[/b] – More options, more control.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Controller Support[/b] – It’s here! (Still a bit rough in places).[/p][/*][*][p][b]Minigame Winlobby[/b] - Full Rework[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Minigame Thumbnails[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]GG-Party Mode / Open World[/b] – Over 80 game design improvements:[/p][list][*][p]Fully overhauled [b]Quest System[/b] – more robust and flexible.[/p][/*][*][p]Added [b]Minimap, Map & Compass[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]All available [b]vehicles can be bought and driven[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Standard houses can be upgraded with [b]GPUs for extra income[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Sabotage houses, shops & more[/b], directly impacting income, shop prices, etc.[/p][/*][*][p]New [b]wire minigame[/b] to repair sabotaged places.[/p][/*][*][p][b]53 unique NPCs[/b] with their own characters and dialogues.[/p][/*][*][p]…and tons more![/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p]⚡️ This is just the beginning—dive in and see the changes for yourself![/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41802577/d47ad781280bab064c500e54539f7bf038a61323.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Stay tuned—much love from the GoraGames team ❤️[/b][/p]

notes.title: Small netcode updates for Tacticbombs
notes.notes:
-General: An additional UI element has been added to display the player's current ping when experiencing a poor connection.

-Tacticbomb: Bombs now have the ability to destroy each other upon collision.
-Tacticbomb: Bombs will now appear even when playing with high latency on clients. However, one caveat is that in situations of excessively high latency, it may give the appearance of the bomb resetting itself.
-Helicopter: The behavior of rockets has been fine-tuned for improved gameplay.
